textBox.richText: Thom and Brecken - Air Force Academy, Cadet Chapel

Thom and I met with a few different chaplains before we found what we were looking for in Paul. Unlike others, Paul did not have a pre-written standard ceremony. Rather, he used a speech that was unique to us as a couple. Paul was willing to meet with us as many times as we needed and to help out with issues big or small. We would recommend Paul because he is so accommodating and works to make your day just as you want it!
